group.description:
LAbRoio is a multidisciplinary research group at [University of L'Aquila](http://www.univaq.it/) with a thermo-physical laboratory focused on smart energy management models. Our aim is to give intelligence to a node called "prosumer"  (energy PROducer and conSUMER) by optimizing loads demands and energy supply. An example may be the cooling load of an air conditioner in daily/monthly operation during summer time, when the energy bill is dominated by it. Providing intelligence to the node translate to give forecasting capabilities to the heat control system based on ICT technology extendible to the entire electrical grid.

For information contact:

* Mario Gimenez De Lorenzo  **magidel** AT **gmail** DOT **com**
* Giovanni De Gasperis  **giovanni.degasperis** AT **univaq** DOT **it**

References

* F. Muzi, M. Gimenz De Lorenzo, G. De Gasperis - Intelligence Improvement of a "Prosumer" Node Through the Predictive Concept. IEEE-EMS 2012, UKSim-AMSS 6th European Modelling Symposium on Mathematical Modelling and Computer Simulation, Malta, 14–16 November 2012.

* Caianiello, P., S. Costantini, G. D. Gasperis, and M. Gimenez De Lorenzo, "Application of Hybrid Agents to Smart Energy Management of a Prosumer Node", International Jorunal of Interactive Multimedia and Artificial Intelligence, vol. 2, issue Regular Issue, no. 4, pp. 60-66, 12/2013

package.name: node-prosumer-energy-management
package.author: Mario Gimenez De Lorenzo, Giovanni De Gasperis, Francesco Muzi
package.notes:
Dataset is about a study on energy management of a node prosumer.

The initial part of this study is based on the modeling of the laboratory system: blackbox approach. Having available as a single load consumption of the air conditioner, we want to model the thermal zone using a dataset of measures including thermal and climatic variables and consumption too.

The lab represents our prosumer node, at least in the part of consumption. Modeled the system, we proceed to estimate the load on the air conditioner. Awarded prediction, we have the basic information to optimize the energy demand. This is the basis of the intelligence of the node.

The laboratory, in which these measurements were taken, is located in Monteluco Roio, L'Aquila. Its coordinates are:
* latitude 42 ° 20.273' N * longitude 13 ° 22:55' E * altitude 940 The weather station, from which the climatic measures were taken, is located near the laboratory. Its coordinates are:
* latitude 42 ° 20,244' N * longitude 13 ° 22,611' E * altitude 960 The sizes range from the date 07.26.2014, 01:30 h on the date 09.02.2014, 09:30 h.
The time resolution of the measurements is 15 minutes
Below is a description of the fields.
* **TimeS**: fifteen canonical transformed in seconds
* **Ta**: Ambient temperature
* **Rs**: Radiation
* **Power**: instantaneous consumption at the quarter hour
* **PowerAVG**: average consumption in fifteen minutes (a)
* **Tin_windAVG**: the average quarter hour of the internal temperature sensor near the air conditioner (b)
* **Tin_doorAVG**: the average quarter hour of the internal temperature sensor away from the air conditioner (b)
* **Tin_wind**: instantaneous value in the quarter-hour of the internal temperature sensor near the air conditioner
* **Tin_door**: instantaneous value in the quarter-hour of the internal temperature sensor away from the air conditioner
* **SetPoint**: the value of the reference temperature (c)


(a) soon (b) soon (c) soon Collaborators Francesco Muzi: http://www.ing.univaq.it/personale/scheda_personale.php?codice=214 Giovanni De Gasperis: http://www.disim.univaq.it/main/home.php?users_username=giovanni.degasperis

The laboratory, in which these measurements were taken, is located in Monteluco Roio, L'Aquila. Its coordinates are:
* latitude 42 ° 20.273' N * longitude 13 ° 22:55' E * altitude 940 The weather station, from which the climatic measures were taken, is located near the laboratory. Its coordinates are:
* latitude 42 ° 20,244' N * longitude 13 ° 22,611' E * altitude 960 The sizes range from the date 07.26.2014, 01:30 h on the date 09.02.2014, 09:30 h.
The time resolution of the measurements is 15 minutes
Below is a description of the fields.
* **TimeS**: fifteen canonical transformed in seconds
* **Ta**: Ambient temperature
* **Rs**: Radiation
* **Power**: instantaneous consumption at the quarter hour
* **PowerAVG**: average consumption in fifteen minutes (a)
* **Tin_windAVG**: the average quarter hour of the internal temperature sensor near the air conditioner (b)
* **Tin_doorAVG**: the average quarter hour of the internal temperature sensor away from the air conditioner (b)
* **Tin_wind**: instantaneous value in the quarter-hour of the internal temperature sensor near the air conditioner
* **Tin_door**: instantaneous value in the quarter-hour of the internal temperature sensor away from the air conditioner
* **SetPoint**: the value of the reference temperature (c)

group.description: LAbRoio is a research group on issues thermo-physical-energy-information. Our aim is to give intelligence to a node called "prosumer" in its energy management (energy PROducer and conSUMER) by optimizing loads more energy-intensive system. An example may be the load of an air conditioner in daily/monthly operation. Equip the node of this intelligence means extend to the entire grid. Hence the creation of a True Smart Grid.
